comment: The set every skin may use: white shapes on a transparent ground, tinted in the game with SetColor.
Sizes are layout units (the window layouts' unit); the atlas is drawn at 1.5 px per unit.
mark_*  the status marks of a node (locked, done, researching, unknown), 24x24, drawn in a 2.4..3 unit line.
chip    the square before a point line in the pool and in the price row, 10x10.
and_square  the knot where the links of an 'all of' node meet, 10x10.
or_diamond  the knot of an 'any of' node, 16x16 over the box, a 2 unit outline only.
